```{r}
#| include: false
# Shared setup, included at the top of every chapter.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = "#>", fig.align = "center", dpi = 150)

# Which Python runs the {python} cells. .Rprofile declares the same libraries for
# interactive work; this repeats it so that a render does not depend on a startup
# file being read. RETICULATE_PYTHON, if set, wins over both.
if (requireNamespace("reticulate", quietly = TRUE) &&
    !nzchar(Sys.getenv("RETICULATE_PYTHON")) &&
    exists("py_require", envir = asNamespace("reticulate"))) {
  try(reticulate::py_require(c("pandas", "numpy", "matplotlib", "seaborn",
                               "scikit-learn", "joblib")), silent = TRUE)
}
```
